card.title: Safety Through Nonsense
card.instruction: Take control through elaborate impossible precautions, treating every objection as another reason the people present need protection.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Helmet on before reading the prophecy. We haven't inspected tomorrow for falling objects.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's one sentence. I just want to know if the picnic's on.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Short prophecies concentrate the future. Read it through this oven glove.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It predicts sunshine. Surely that's safe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Unfiltered future sunlight. Close the glove. Nobody reads another word until I've put sunscreen on tomorrow.

mechanism: A controls prophecy reading through physical protective equipment and treats even a sunny forecast as concentrated future exposure.
confusable: Unlike interpreting a prophecy to preserve a prediction, A is inventing protective measures that keep others from proceeding unaided.
comparison: The prophecy alternative stops reading to protect tomorrow itself; the ribbon alternative takes over eating after the precautions impair B's hands.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
